title: Buy now, pay later plans will soon impact your credit score—what you need to know
summary: CNBC Make It article on FICO's new BNPL-inclusive credit score model and associated risks.

assertions.quote: FICO...announced Monday it would be releasing a credit score model this fall that considers BNPL loans
nearly two-thirds of BNPL loans went to users with low credit scores
63% of BNPL users took out multiple loans at the same time in the last year
BNPL users routinely spend more than non-users, a recent study showed
41% of BNPL users were late on a payment in the last year
